state.product: Miu World: a free 3D voxel learning game for Vietnamese grade-2 children (age 7-8). Each quest is one real textbook lesson (Tiếng Việt 2, Toán 2) wrapped in a story; the child walks in a 3D forest/school, meets animal NPCs, and answers textbook exercises on 2D themed scene screens (wood banner, parchment panels, stone tiles) drawn over the paused 3D world.
state.devices: iPad first (touch), phones secondary. Parents set it up; children play alone.
state.owner_feedback: The owner reviewed 6 sample quests and said they are not yet good enough; they asked to make the experience more fitting and richer (phong phú hơn) before 64 more quests are written on the same template.
current_state: Reading passages and prompts render around 16px body text on parchment; choice buttons medium size.
Right/wrong feedback is a text line from the NPC (rotating pools, never repeated back to back); no visual effect, no sound.
Completion screen: static card with 3 stars, +XP and +Xu tiles (shows +0 Xu when zero), two buttons.
Step progress is a small chip 'Bước 3/11'.
Scene panels leave large translucent empty areas; tiles are chunky but the overall energy is low.
Support buttons 'Hướng dẫn', 'Gợi ý', 'Đáp án' are small pills always available; the server scores stars lower when the answer layer is used.
NPC portrait is a static Fluent 3D emoji image beside the speech bubble.
A CC0 Kenney Interface Sounds pack (clicks, confirmations, errors, glass, drops) is already in the asset manifest but no sound effects are played; a sound on/off toggle exists in the pause menu.
constraints: Textbook wording must appear verbatim; decoration may surround it but not change it.
No new paid art, no hand drawing, no AI-generated images; only CC0/MIT/OFL packs already in the repo (Kenney, Fluent Emoji) and code-drawn effects.
Every line and scene must feel fresh: loops rotate varied content.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; keep 44px+ touch targets; iPad performance matters.

UI/UX guidance for children's educational apps recommends a playful claymorphism style (soft 3D, chunky, thick borders, double shadows), Baloo 2 display font, clear success/error feedback, and avoiding muted colors with low energy.

reading_size.instructions: How large should textbook reading passages and exercise prompts be on the scene screens for 7-8 year olds on an iPad?

criteria.larger: Passages ~22px with line-height 1.6 and prompts ~20px; choice and tile labels at least 20px.
criteria.largest_with_follow: Passages ~26px, and when the child taps 'Nghe' the line being read is highlighted as it plays.

right_feedback.instructions: What should happen when the child answers correctly?

criteria.text_only: Keep the NPC's text line only.
criteria.burst: A short burst of stars/sparkles from the answer, the NPC portrait does a happy bounce, a cheerful confirmation sound, then the NPC's line.
criteria.fullscreen: A full-screen celebration overlay with confetti every time.

wrong_feedback.instructions: What should happen when the child answers wrong?

criteria.text_only: Keep the NPC's text line only.
criteria.gentle: The wrong tiles/choice give a gentle shake and a soft tone, the correct parts stay in place, the NPC shows an encouraging bubble (no red 'X', no harsh buzzer).
criteria.detailed: Mark exactly which items are wrong in red with an explanation each time.

completion.instructions: How should the quest completion screen feel?

criteria.sequence: Animated sequence: stars pop in one by one with rising tones, XP and coins count up, the main NPC and Miu appear celebrating, zero rewards are hidden.
criteria.sequence_and_world: The animated sequence plus Miu jumping for joy in the 3D world after the card closes.

progress.instructions: How should a child see progress through a quest's 11-21 steps?

criteria.trail: A trail of leaves/stones on the banner: done ones filled, current one glowing, remaining ones outlined; the phase names (Gặp gỡ, Khám phá, Học, Thử thách…) are not shown to children.
criteria.none: No progress indicator; the story carries the child.

panel_energy.instructions: How to address the large empty translucent areas and low energy of the scene panels?

criteria.clay: Panels size to their content (no empty filler), chunkier claymorphism treatment (thicker borders, double soft shadows, rounded 20px), brighter material colors, bigger tiles (64px+ tall), and a subtle themed backdrop pattern per mechanic.
criteria.fullbleed: Make every mechanic full-screen with an illustrated background instead of a panel over the world.

support_buttons.instructions: How should the three support layers (Hướng dẫn = how to do it, Gợi ý = hint, Đáp án = show answer) be offered? Using the answer lowers the stars; learning value matters.

criteria.keep: Keep three small pills always available.
criteria.progressive: Chunky icon+label buttons; Hướng dẫn always, Gợi ý after the first wrong try, Đáp án only after two wrong tries (the NPC offers it), keeping the child trying first.
criteria.hint_only: Remove the answer button entirely; only guide and hint.

npc_presence.instructions: How alive should the NPC beside the speech bubble be, given only one Fluent 3D emoji image per animal is available?

criteria.reactive: Code-driven reactions on the same image: a small bounce when speaking, tilt/wiggle when thinking, jump on a right answer, lean in to encourage on a wrong one (reduced-motion: none).
criteria.live_3d: Render the NPC's 3D Cube Pets model live in the panel instead of the emoji.

sound.instructions: Should the game play sound effects from the CC0 Kenney Interface Sounds pack already in the repo, honouring the existing sound toggle?

criteria.core: Soft sounds for taps, placing a tile, right answer, gentle tone for wrong, rising chimes on completion; varied variants so they never feel repeated; off by the toggle.
criteria.core_and_music: The core sounds plus looping background music (none is in the repo yet; would need a new CC0 source).
